title: Trump on the New Jersey drones

tellings.quote: Our military knows where they took off from. If it's a garage, they can go right into that garage.

plain: Donald Trump said the US military knows exactly where the mysterious drones seen over New Jersey in 2024 came from. In a clip played on the show, Trump says: "Our military knows where they took off from. If it's a garage, they can go right into that garage." It is told because it suggests the government knew more about the drones than it was saying.
